text_block_list.text:
One evening, behind the dimly lit school building,
Tamamo Cross and Ines Fujin silently arrived
with grave expressions.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I snagged the carrots and potatoes from the supermarket by the station!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You're a lifesaver~! Here you go, this is Tamamo-san's shampoo and toothbrush!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm so grateful~ What a lifesaver~.
A friend in frugality is a friend indeed, huh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. As long as Tamamo-san is with me,
overlapping timed sales aren't scary at all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody knows the local sales better than us!
Man, this feels so good!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Right, to show my appreciation for everything,
I'll sell ya some top-secret intel!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! You can do a trick like that
with milk and potatoes!?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Shh!
Ya never know who might be listenin'!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, is this something
I shouldn't be hearing?

All in all,
their lively conversation about money-saving tips
continued until the sun went down.
